title: Volume is way to high in build 0223-80e1023
symptom: Volume of the device (phone) is completely ignored by xDrip in the version from 23rd of Feb 2019. Changing the volume profile in xDrip between High and Medium doesn't make any difference; it's really really loud. The issue persists in later builds, and medium feels at least 50% higher than in older versions.
evidence_quote: Volume of the device (phone) is completely ignored by xdrip in the version from 23rd of Feb 2019. Also changing the volume profile in xdrip it self between High and Medium doesn't make any difference. It's really really loud.
